verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says it automates invoice approval and payments, so payment approval exists as a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows configuring approver permissions for designated teammates or a one-click approve-and-send action. The 'one click' claim refers to accruals, not payments, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented approval-permission/role configuration, designation of specific teammates as approvers, a one-click approve-and-send payment flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set up approval permissions so designated teammates can approve and send payments with one click

citations.quote: Save time with AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments.
